verdict.rationale: Fivetran offers some event-driven automation — alerts (fivetran-docs-15), webhooks with custom payload logic (fivetran-docs-47), and transformations auto-triggered after syncs or on schedule (fivetran-docs-37) — but there is no general-purpose rules engine letting users define arbitrary conditional 'if event X then action Y' logic. Missing for 10: a documented rule/condition builder for custom trigger-action automation beyond built-in alerts/webhooks/scheduled transforms, and independent evidence of users building such automations.
